name: portable-compression
description: Create and safely extract ZIP and TAR.GZ archives with bundled, OS-independent compression code.

interface.shortDescription: Create and safely extract ZIP and TAR.GZ files.
interface.longDescription: Portable Compression creates deterministic ZIP and TAR.GZ archives and safely extracts them using compression code bundled with the plugin. It does not require an MCP server, network service, external package, or operating-system archive utility.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create or safely extract a portable archive.
